description: Combat the elements with our iconic MA-1 Flight Jacket, equipped with warm poly fiberfill for exceptional insulation, keeping you warm in cold conditions. The military-styled bomber jacket features a nylon water-repellent outer shell that provides protection from light rain and snow. Unbeatable Comfort and Warmth: These aviator flight jackets feature a soft ribbed knit collar, cuffs, and waistband for additional heat retention and insulation while blocking out the wind. The MA-1 military bomber jacket has an extra full cut for a comfortable fit with room underneath for extra layers, ideal for winter and cold weather. Utility Pockets: The military pilot’s coat comes equipped with 5 pockets: 2 front slash pockets and 2 inner welt pockets for everyday essentials, and what’s a bomber jacket without a zippered utility sleeve pocket!? Along with exterior pen holders, this useful pocket is great for storing small items. Iconic MA-1 Styling: Inspired by the original design for fighter pilots, our rugged and dependable MA-1 Flight Bomber Jackets feature a reversible orange polyester lining that offers alternative style options. The zippered front closure with double ‘MA-1’ pull tabs and storm flap, brass zippers, and leather pull tab pays homage to the jacket’s heritage, functionality, and style. Take Flight: Whether you are military personnel, aviation enthusiast, or outdoor adventurer, the pilot bomber jacket is perfect as a windbreaker for spring and fall seasons while presenting a classic style that is great for casual outings and everyday use.
